text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — I pushed a draft of the release notes for the embargoed vector-cache feature. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/vector-cache (do not publish yet).
Emma Li: Thanks Alex. Is there a short 'known issues' blurb we should include about cache invalidation when rolling older model variants?
Alex Chen: Good call — added a Known Issues section but it's terse. Suggest we call out: 'KV cache invalidation may cause transient diffs for prompt variations < 16 tokens'.
Miguel Santos: I'll own the migration guide updates. I noticed the embeddings -> cached-embeddings migration steps need a code example tweak for the Python SDK (auth flow changed).
Sasha K: Also found a stale internal redirect on the caching page: /docs/caching -> returns 404 from the preview. Pinged eng-infra.
docs-bot: Preview build created for branch feature/vec-cache-relnotes — https://staging.builds.redwood.ai/preview/3821 (updated at 1763332255).
Emma Li: Can we include a short example showing the new `cache_ttl` param in Python? Something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate("Hello", model="kestrel-4", cache_ttl=3600)
```
Alex Chen: Perfect — Miguel can you add that to the PR (docs PR #482)? Also note: embargo until Fri 9am PT per PM.
Miguel Santos: Will add snippet and update the migration steps. Also will add a note about fallbacks to quantized variants for lower-latency tiers.
Sasha K: Eng-infra replied — redirect fix merged in infra, preview will reflect it after next build (ETA ~10m).
Emma Li: One more: please verify all links in the relnotes to the console docs are absolute (we've had link-rot before). I can do a linkcheck sweep after your update. :mag:
Alex Chen: Thanks — if everyone can review the PR by EOD tomorrow I'll queue for copy sign-off. Tagging @Emma Li and @Miguel Santos for review. :thumbsup:
Miguel Santos: On it. I expect a small follow-up commit for snippet alignment and a migration note about rolling keys.
Sasha K: Preview looks good now — redirect fixed.
Alex Chen: Cool. Locking the thread until we have the final copy and embargo flag cleared. If anything urgent, DM.
Emma Li: LGTM pending the updated Python snippet and a one-line known-issue about short-sequence diffs.
Miguel Santos: PR updated (commit 9a7b2f) — added snippet and migration note.
Alex Chen: Awesome, thanks all. I will schedule the publish and add the 'embargoed' meta flag in the release pipeline. :white_check_mark:
